title: spooky and cookies
description: Ghosts and cookies in one place—free the spirit of terror and enjoy a wide variety of cosmetics.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fedbcb6063c94f19341ba99d04990d113a0703f5.png)

This datapack includes:
- Spooky Trader
- Spooky Ghost
- Spooky Cookie (4 variants)
- Spooky Potion (2 variants)


 ![wallpaper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9e33b12f5ccf49fdebd2a4a271a5280cd33be2f.png) 
Steps for each ritual:
- Spooky and Cookies Ritual: Drop a Halloween pumpkin or Jack-o'-lantern, then from a height of 2 blocks, throw that item into fire.
- Ritual to summon the Spooky Trader: Throw a spooky candy into water.

Dependency: [spooky and cookies (resource pack)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spooky-and-cookies-resource-pack)
